description: Sub-file for today live market data containing precomputed short-term static and long-term static data with specific columns, mathematical calculations, and plain-language interpretations.

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 22.57 (2.83%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 28.21 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 792.67. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 818.34), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 772.34).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 22.5 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 838.22.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 27.79 per share on a book value of Rs. 180.9 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 137.3% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 336.3).

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1360.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1020.03. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1032.06), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1000.06).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 28.5 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1038.25.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 184.2% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 356.1).

dividend_track_record.statistical_calculation: 5-year weighted mean of bonus share entitlements and cash dividend declarations

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 16.17 (1.38%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 20.21 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1163.33. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1174.66), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1157.66).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 5.4% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 419.6% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 13.63 (3.28%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 17.04 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 413.2. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 421.9), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 407.4).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 44.3 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 417.28.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 84.9% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 11.46 (1.92%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 14.33 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 597.77. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 599.34), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 595.54).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 4.2% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 165.4% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 164.4% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).
